round: V35: bonus-cycle rule from the official app, and a search that uses it
status: frozen before any V35 evaluation game
evidence: two complete games auto-played in the official iPhone app (moves 1530 and 1714): every complete block of 21 previews counted from the first draw after move 1 held exactly one bonus (70/70 and 78/78), no bonus gap above 41 (149 gaps), one back-to-back pair at a block boundary. An independent 1/21 chance per draw would give no gap above 41 in 149 gaps with probability ~4e-10.
rule: opening preview = draw 0; draws 1-21, 22-42, ... are blocks; at each block start one position is drawn uniformly (hidden); at that draw the preview is a bonus if max card >= 48 (window rule unchanged), else the slot is lost; all other draws come from the 12-card basic deck (training/v35-cycle/cgame.h). Rule test: 20,000 random games, 1,410 blocks checked, all with exactly one bonus, max gap 41.

arms.U: website search (V31 float model, depth 5, cutoff 0.01, clamp) with the old constant 1/21 bonus chance
arms.A: the same search with the cycle-aware chance (search5c.h): 0 after the block bonus, else 1/(21 - excluded positions); the AI tracks the cycle from previews only

parity: with cycleAware=false search5c.h equals search5s.h bit for bit (directions, depths, root values) on the 320 V25 browser states; aware changes the direction on 18 of 320 states with arbitrary cycle states
games: whole games, standard openings, to 12288 or death, same seed per pair (after decisions diverge the random events differ)

primary.P1: reach 6144, exact McNemar A vs U

multiplicity: Holm across P1-P3; no interim analysis
secondary: reach 3072, P(12288 | 6144), Wilson intervals, CPU ms per move; descriptive comparison of U under the cycle rule with V31 under the old rule (different seeds, unpaired)
adoption: If A is Holm-significantly better on any primary and not significantly worse on the others, the website engine and AI move to the cycle rule in a later release (JS work, parity and timing checks needed then).
